clusters.title: A question with no blank asks for nominal / bare Pn / one limit state / ASD / excess / percent / L/r / KL / Euler critical stress / KL/r about x, and the form's governing phi Pn (or K, Pcr) stays a clean ANSWER
clusters.root_cause: [prose-ask-qualifier] pipeline.js prose path. The words that change the quantity live only on the blank path, in wordId line 922 (`excess|extra|percent|nominal|allowable|asd|omega ...`) and lines 925-941 (yield -> phipn_y, rupture -> phipn_r). The sentence path never applies them. (1) asksInProse line 1002 needs an asking verb, or 2+ symbols with no digit, so 'nominal yield strength', 'design strength for yielding?', 'gross yielding?', 'phi Pn for rupture', 'L/r?' and '(d) rupture strength' ask nothing. (2) ASK_WORDS 975-999 has no bare 'Pn'/'nominal' entry. The phipn entry (989) matches 'tensile strength' inside 'nominal tensile strength' and becomes the form's own result. There is no 'rupture strength' / 'yielding strength' entry. The fe entry (998) has no /i flag and no 'euler critical stress'. The klr entry (978) ignores 'about the x axis', and there is no prose 'KL'. (3) askedInWords 1007-1035 has no qualifier test. (4) The limit-state block in signaturePass 1334-1343 already detects 'for yielding' / 'rupture strength' (ls = 'y' / 'r'), but only RENAMES an existing phipn ask, and here there is none. (5) writeBlock line 3841: allProse never demotes the form's ANSWER while STRENGTH_ASK (1038) matches 'strength' / 'capacity'. I confirmed on the branch that tcap-31 parts (c) and (d) still print the governing 596.2 as ANSWER.
clusters.fix_plan: [prose-ask-qualifier] Put a small helper in a NEW file (or wordsx.js), called at the end of askedInWords, with one-line hunks in signaturePass and writeBlock. (1) A part's LAST sentence with no digit that ends in '?' or is a bare noun phrase naming a known quantity counts as asking. (2) Apply wordId's qualifier list to the asking sentence. 'allowable|ASD|omega' gives a not-in-tool sentence (one sentence, no number: her class is LRFD), so tsel-29 / ccap-283 STOP. 'excess|extra|additional|margin|percent|utiliz|remaining|reserve' pushes an UNKNOWN ask (part.unknownBlanks = the phrase). The existing 'CHECK YOUR BLANK' line then stands under the ANSWER (tsel-23/24/25: not clean, no new number). (3) 'nominal' or a bare 'Pn' (no phi) gives id pn / pn_y / pn_r with the limit-state words. SIG_NOMINAL then prints column Pn = phi Pn / 0.9 (ccap-269/270: 974.4, unambiguous) and tension Pn_y = yielding/0.9, Pn_r = rupture/0.75 (tsel-27: 332.3; tcap-26: 485.5... only if Pn_y/Pn_r come from her phis). A tension 'Pn' with no limit state (two phis) is an UNKNOWN ask, so a CHECK warning shows (tcap-24/25, tsel-26). Exclude 'nominal' before the phipn ASK_WORDS match. (4) signaturePass 1342: when ls is set and no phipn/pn ask exists on a tension part, push a prose ask phipn_y / phipn_r (pn_y / pn_r with 'nominal'). This ANSWERs the form's own yielding/rupture value (702, 437, 135.9, 318.6): unambiguous by her method. (5) writeBlock 3841: allProse also demotes the form's ANSWER to ALSO FOUND when every prose ask is one of {phipn_y, phipn_r, pn, pn_y, pn_r, fe, klrx, klry, kl}, even when STRENGTH_ASK matches. (6) ASK_WORDS: fe gets /i and 'Euler (critical|buckling) stress' (ANSWER Fe 20.28). 'KL/r about the x|strong|major axis' maps to klrx, and y|weak|minor to klry (ANSWER 55.56). 'effective length KL' / a final 'KL' maps to 'kl' (existing id; only with one length: ANSWER 16 ft). 'L/r?' is caught by (1) (ANSWER 96.8). MUST NOT CHANGE: 'Determine the design tensile strength. Report An, U and Ae' (the strength stays ANSWER), her review 'Find: Euler Pcr, the AISC phi Pn' (never flagged), 'for yielding and rupture' (no single limit state), the whole blank path, and 'Design strength for yielding of the gross section' (already right). Run harness/regress.sh and classify every changed line.

clusters.title: A REQUIRED area (Ag required, min Ag, required Ae / net area) is answered with the chosen shape's Ag, or with the required-Ag headline when Ae was asked + signaturePass keeps or picks a form that does not answer: a prose ask no form gives leaves an unrelated answer clean, a reroute crosses to another member family with no word for it, a referring part becomes a definition
clusters.root_cause:
[required-area-ask] pipeline.js. In wordId, the in2 symbol shortcut at line 936 (`/ ag /` -> 'ag') runs BEFORE the required/minimum/min/needed guard at line 954. 'Ag required = ____ in2' becomes id 'ag', and SIG_VALUE.ag (/^Ag$/ first) returns the selected W8X18's 5.26 (tsel-20). askedInWords line 1016 SKIPS ag/an/ae whenever 'required|minimum|needed|necessary' is in the sentence. So 'required Ae?' and 'required net area' add no ask and the form's 'Required gross area: Ag' headline stays clean (tsel-18/19). The list has no 'min', so 'min Ag?' adds a plain 'ag' ask that returns the shape's Ag (tsel-21). tsel-09: the frozen finder routes 'required gross area' with no tension word to loads_factored, and no amendRoute rule (760-787) corrects it. Its live load ('3 times the dead load') is also unread (load-pair-half-missing). The engine already holds Ag_required (tension_select, tension_required_area) and Ae_required (tension_required_area).
[form-choice-guards] pipeline.js signaturePass. (a) Line 1448 `else if (proseOnly) { /* ... stays ... unflagged */ }`: when a sentence asks for something (the 'lightest W12' shape ask, an Ae ask) that the finished form does not give (curScore 0) and no other form can run, the finder's form is printed as a clean ANSWER. csel-20/21 print 'Factored load: 500 kips' for 'select lightest W12', and tcap-33 prints the welded capacity for 'find the effective net area'. The column form could not run because findLengths (1298-1299) is case-sensitive on 'kxlx=kyly=14ft' and fillEnds does not read a bare 'pinned'. (b) Reroute loop 1400-1447 with sigConflict 1146-1150: a candidate of another member family is excluded only when another family's words appear and its own do not. With no member word at all ('choose lightest w12 Pu=500k length 14 ft') tension_select is taken silently (csel-26). The compression regex C has no Kx/Ky/'K ='/effective length, so 'Kx = 1.0, Ky = 0.8' went to tension_capacity (648 for 527; ccap-277). (c) The frozen finder routes part (b) 'repeat if it is braced at mid height about the weak axis' to lookup_definition. REF_RE (line 613) protects only 'repeat (a)', and no guard stops a calculation part from becoming a words answer (ccap-195).
clusters.fix_plan:
[required-area-ask] pipeline.js, small hunks. (1) wordId: move the `/ required | minimum | min | needed | req d /` test above the in2 shortcuts (935-936). Map 'required/min Ag' to a new id 'agreq' (SIG_VALUE [/^Ag_required$/]) and 'required Ae' to 'aereq' ([/^Ae_required$/]). Add both to SIG_LABEL. In sigGives, tension_required_area gives agreq (main) and aereq (also), and tension_select gives agreq (also). (2) askedInWords 1016: instead of skipping, push agreq / aereq. 'required net area An' has no single value (it needs U and the hole layout), so push an UNKNOWN ask and the CHECK warning shows. (3) tsel-09: one amendRoute rule. 'required (gross|effective) area' / 'Ag required' with loads in kips and no column/beam/moment word moves to tension_required_area. Its unread live load then gets the load-pair ask. ANSWER: required Ag = Pu/(0.9 Fy) and required Ae = Pu/(0.75 Fu) (D2a/D2b, her method: tsel-20/21 4.889, tsel-19 3.938, tsel-18 Ae 3.034). ASK/CHECK: required An. MUST NOT CHANGE: 'Ag = ____' of a capacity question (the shape's own Ag), 'Show Ag required and the L/r check' extra lines, beams' required Zx (lookup_by_property rule 2), the C-48 'a36 is not a required Zx' rule.
[form-choice-guards] pipeline.js, small hunks (with the coverage bits in reader.js). (a) Line 1448: when curOk and the form gives NONE of the prose asks and one ask is 'shape' (a selection was asked and a non-selection answered), set part.askedMismatch. The existing 'NOT WHAT YOUR BLANK ASKS' line then shows. Start that narrow. Extend it to {ae, an, u} asks on a tension form only if regress.sh shows no right answer flagged. The 10/07 01:15 dump is why prose asks are weak evidence, but that case is covered by the earlier 'gives at least one' continue. Coverage: findLengths reads 'kxlx=kyly=14ft' case-insensitively, and fillEnds reads a bare 'pinned' as pinned-pinned. csel-20 then gives W12X53 and csel-21 gives W12X50. (b) Reroute: a candidate whose family differs from the finder's route family needs a word of ITS OWN family in the text. Add `\bK\s?[xy]\s*=|\bK\s*=\s*\d|effective\s+length|\bK\s?L\b` to C. With no member word at all, ASK (need/choice: column or tension member). Never pick one silently: csel-26 ASKs, and ccap-277 stops on its end conditions or is answered by cluster column-segments-and-per-axis-K. (c) A lettered part that refers back (repeat / same column / 'if it is braced ...') and has no shape or length of its own is not routed to a definition. Extend REF_RE, or carry (a)'s stem, or ASK. A words answer under a lettered part whose sibling is a calculation gets a warning. MUST NOT CHANGE: the 10/07 01:15 cases (prose asks never flag a part that gives one of them), the floor-plan ways out, the 'named member is never moved to a selection' rule, word questions and multiple choice (C-48).

clusters.title: A condition the words state, but no box takes, passes without blocking: an unread member length (no L/r check), the L/r > 300 verdict, an unread effective length, self-weight in the maximum live load, a typed phi, a named table
clusters.root_cause: [stated-condition-dropped] The common thread: pipeline.js unusedQuestions line 2754 makes an unplaced plain length (and any unitless number or stress) non-blocking, and nothing else checks the stated condition. (a) reader.js tensionCommon 1751-1754 sets length_ft only from findLengths (1284-1370) 'N ft long' / 'length N ft' / 'N-ft member'. 'L = 25 ft' goes to L.items, a bare '25ft' is not read, and 'unbraced length 25 ft' is skipped (line 1334). So tension_select runs without its L/r <= 300 check (W10X17 for W10X22; tsel-14/15/16). (b) pipeline.js writeBlock 3874-3880 builds the YES/NO from lv.adequate (the engine's phi Pn >= Pu) and never looks at lv.L_over_r (355 > 300; tsel-17). (c) columnLengths (1817-1829) reads 'effective length 25 ft' only with axis words, and findLengths skips it. pipeline carryAcross step 3 (3483-3500) then fills (b)'s empty lengths from (a) (csel-12). (d) FILL.loads_max_service (2525-2530) never checks selfWeight(F) for 'include self weight' (tsel-36). (e) There is no stop for a typed 'phi = 0.85', and computeUnused collects only numbers with a unit (ccap-202). (f) writeBlock copies the engine headline (Table 4-1a when KL is the same both ways, the KL/r route otherwise) and never checks the table the question NAMES ('using table 4-14', 'from Table 4-1a'; ccap-62/159).
clusters.fix_plan: [stated-condition-dropped] (a) reader.js: in a tension part, read 'L = N ft' (a member-length symbol with no axis), 'unbraced length N ft', and a bare 'N ft' that is the ONLY length of a tension question, into length_ft. That is unambiguous: the member length for L/r. ANSWER W10X22. pipeline unusedQuestions 2754: an unplaced length in a tension_select / tension_capacity part is blocking (ASK where it goes). (b) writeBlock verdict 3874: when lv.L_over_r > 300, print NO with the reason. Her select applies L/r <= 300 as a requirement, and the page's own tension_select does too. If the owner prefers zero choice, print a STOP sentence instead. Never a bare YES. (c) columnLengths: a plain 'effective length N ft' with no axis is KL for both axes (ANSWER W14X120). carryAcross step 3 does not carry into a part that has its own unplaced length (ASK). (d) loads_max_service: with 'self weight' in the words and the shape and length read, D = D + wt x L/1000 is shown (her method: dead load includes self weight; ANSWER 125.40). If either is missing, ASK (need). (e) 'phi = x' (or 'phi c = x') with x other than her 0.90 (0.75 for tension rupture) gives a one-sentence STOP. (f) When the words name 'table 4-14' and the headline is Table 4-1a, the ANSWER line is the KL/r-route value the engine already prints (466.6). When they name 'table 4-1a' and the headline is the KL/r route, use the engine's Table 4-1a step value (478) only if it is in the result; otherwise a CHECK warning. MUST NOT CHANGE: 'Not used' notes for bolt spacing and edge distance (the 10/06 rule: 16 false stops), selects that give no length (the 'L/r not checked' NOTE stays), the her-method headline when no table is named, KL given with axis labels.
